biography.plain_text: Dr Mohamed Hamdan Abdulla Al Shamsi is an Emirati dentist and former federal health administrator. The first UAE national to study dentistry abroad, he became a long-serving director of dental health services, planning and research at the Ministry of Health. His public career helped place oral health within the country's developing federal healthcare system.

long_biography.plain_text:
Sheikh Maktoum bin Rashid Al Maktoum financed Mohamed Al Shamsi's university education at a time when overseas study was beyond his family's means. Al Shamsi selected Cairo University, joining a small group of graduates whose tuition, accommodation and monthly support were covered. He completed his dental education in the early 1970s.

Regional public-health cooperation became another part of Al Shamsi's work. He repeatedly joined UAE delegations to World Health Organization meetings, sometimes as the country's alternate representative. His responsibilities spanned dental services, departmental planning and research, integrating oral healthcare with wider federal health administration.
